## Context
Bug 714b-0b2c-a8f9-468e corrects the alarm_description text in infra/terraform/monitoring_s4b.tf from 3 of 5 to 3 of 6 periods. CloudWatch keeps the old text until Terraform is applied; applying is an operator step.

## Approach
After the change is on main, an operator runs the normal Terraform plan and apply for the monitoring stack and confirms the plan changes only this alarm's description.

## Testing
Read-only check after apply: aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names rebar-gerrit-voter-errors, reading AlarmDescription.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The live AlarmDescription says 3 of 6 five-minute periods (checked: describe-alarms output recorded in a ticket comment).
